articles.summary: New memory modules accelerate data throughput and offer optional Zefr® testing for enhanced reliability in demanding AI workloads Penguin Solutions , Inc. (Nasdaq: PENG ), the AI Factory Platform Company, today announced its newest SMART Modular DDR5 Multi-Ranked Dual In-line Memory Module (MRDIMM), expanding its portfolio of memory solutions designed for AI data centers. Running at industry-leading DDR5-12800 speeds, these new MRDIMMs address growing bandwidth demand created by the exponential growth in AI inference and agentic AI workloads. Demonstrating Penguin’s expertise at the intersection of data center AI infrastructure and memory solutions, the SMART Modular MRDIMMs include industry-leading thermal and electrical protections and utilize an innovative architecture that multiplexes two physical ranks into a single logical rank to avoid traditional speed limitations. This significantly increases memory bandwidth compared to standard RDIMMs, helping improve memory subsystem
articles.title: Penguin Solutions Introduces High-Bandwidth SMART Modular MRDIMMs for Next-Generation AI Data Centers
